lyrics: I cast my ballot just like
my father did.
Stood in the same   line in the
local gym.
But I look at the gears of this grand machine.
And I wonder who is really pulling   the strings.
It sure does not feel
like it belongs   to me.
The doors are open wide but the room is bare
Everybody gets a ticket but nobody   gets a chair
We built this heavy house with a paper in our hand
Now the money comes around and fences   off the land
Welcome to    the Republic
of Nobody
Where the ghost of a vote
still         remains
We are knocking our fists on the
bulletproof glass While the capital drives
the train     Yeah we are
standing in the cold   In the Republic of
Nobody
Every four years they say   it is a
historic fight
But the engine keeps turning   in the
dead of night
I watch my own neighbors   go to war
in the yard    While the men
behind the curtain play   the exact
same card
The doors are open wide but the room is bare
Everybody gets a ticket but nobody gets a chair
We built this heavy house with a   paper in our hand
Now the money comes around and fences   off the land
Welcome to the Republic
of Nobody
Where the     ghost of a vote
still remains
We are knocking our fists on the
bulletproof glass    While the capital drives
the train     Yeah we are
standing in the cold   In the Republic of
Nobody
The vote is
equal.
The voice is not.
